title: OpenAI has updated ChatGPT's voice mode with a new model, GPT-Live-1.1, that sounds more natural and adds new voices.
key_facts: OpenAI updated ChatGPT's voice feature based on the GPT-Live-1.1 voice model
Improves intonation and expression in multiple languages including Korean
Two new Korean voices: male "Hanul" and female "Haetsal"
Uses varied phrases instead of repeating "checking" during searches
Full duplex: users can speak while listening and interrupt
Rolling out sequentially worldwide; free users can use it
quote_evidence: OpenAI said on Thursday it has updated ChatGPT's voice feature based on the GPT-Live-1.1 (GPT-Live-1.1) voice model.
The update improves intonation and vocal expression in multiple languages, including Korean, to help users hold more natural conversations.
The update will be rolled out sequentially to ChatGPT users worldwide, including South Korea.
why_it_matters_hint: More natural voice chat available to free users.
notes: Breakingthenews page had no text; read Digital Today (Korea). Breakingthenews headline says six new voices and another outlet says 13; Digital Today says two Korean voices. No count stated in the entry because outlets disagree.
